caption: A Bollywood romantic pop song featuring expressive, sweet male vocals singing in Hindi with backing vocal hooks and rhythmic vocal samples. The arrangement begins with a syncopated electronic beat and snaps, transitioning into an acoustic guitar and soft keys layered over a smooth, mid-tempo groove with gentle basslines. The mood is warm, affectionate, and breezy, highlighted by clean pop production and romantic melodic phrasing.
lyrics: अगे दी चाशनी औव मिट्टी बिट्टी चाशनी मिट्टी मिट्टी मिट्टी मिट्टी मेरे खयालो में जो तु हो तो बाते हो मैं अच्छी अच्छी करता हो देखो सुबा सुबा जो तुजे तो सारा दिन अच्छा है गुजरता ये कैसी तेरी आर्जू
